subject: Acme Medical - private offer: buyer approval lag & proposed term migration
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmemedical.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmemedical.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood private offer — term ask and internal approvals

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. The team is aligned on moving forward but two blockers from procurement: 1) they need a 36-month committed term in the PO for budgetary rollback protection; and 2) any private offer needs a purchase order and approver signature from the VP of Finance, which can take 3–4 weeks to route.

Attached is our redline of the draft PO (Acme_PO_Draft_v3.pdf). Short question: can Redwood accommodate a staged private offer (12mo active with an option to extend to 36mo under identical pricing) so we don’t delay the kick-off? If not, what are acceptable alternatives?

Jordan
Procurement Manager — Acme Medical
Attachment: Acme_PO_Draft_v3.pdf (PDF)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmemedical.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — term ask and internal approvals

Jordan — thanks for the note and the redline. Looping in Vivek (sales lead) and Marissa (legal ops) to confirm internal feasibility. Quick answers up front:

- We can structure a private offer with a 12-month initial commitment + an option to extend to 36 months, but AWS Marketplace requires the final private offer to reflect the full contracted term for billing/commitment accounting.
- A workaround is a Seller-side credit or a staged billing arrangement to mirror your internal approval timeline while AWS processes the PO.

I'll coordinate with AWS Marketplace contact to confirm how the extension option shows up on the PO and what paperwork they need. Marissa — can you weigh in on whether a seller credit (applied retroactively after extension) is acceptable from Redwood's side?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Marketplace GTM — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — term ask and internal approvals

Hannah / team — reviewed the redline. From a legal/ops perspective:

- We can offer a 12mo private offer with a documented unilateral renewal option (Customer may opt to extend to 36mo within the last 60 days) that preserves pricing and SKU. However, AWS Marketplace will want the final signed private offer to reference the term that triggers their billing.
- Seller credit approach: feasible but must be codified in the SOW/addendum and tracked in our finance systems. It creates additional reconciliation overhead and is typically reserved for strategic commitments.

Recommendation: propose a staged contract (12mo private offer executed immediately) + an early-exercise clause and a conditional 36mo private offer template we pre-fill and keep pending. That minimizes delays and aligns with procurement routing.

Attachment: PO_Signature_Workflow.png (PNG) — shows proposed internal sign path.

Marissa
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
From: marketplace-sales@amazon.com <marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmemedical.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Redwood private offer — term ask and internal approvals

Hi Hannah & Jordan — thanks for the details. AWS Marketplace can accept staged workflows but with constraints:

- The private offer that is accepted in the Marketplace must specify the billing term; if you execute a 12mo today and later want to move to 36mo, you must cancel/replace the original private offer or issue an amendment.
- AWS recommends the use of a DocuSign amendment that references the original private offer ID to keep the lifecycle clean.
- For seller-side credits, ensure you include a clear credit memo and timeline; AWS accounting will need the credit details to reconcile marketplace invoices.

If helpful, we can provisionally generate a private-offer template and the amendment flow; please confirm who on your side will own the DocuSign envelope.

— AWS Marketplace Sales
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmemedical.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — term ask and internal approvals

Jordan — appreciate the transparency on the VP approval timeline. Proposed concession to unblock kickoff:

1) Execute a 12-month private offer now (immediate access and billing).
2) Redwood will place a conditional 24-month extension credit on file (tied to HubSpot deal RW-PO-20261115-ACM). If Acme exercises the extension within 60 days before month 12, we will apply a pro-rated seller credit equivalent to the between-term discount difference.
3) We will own the DocuSign amendment envelope and coordinate with AWS Marketplace to replace the private offer if/when extension executes.

Jordan — does Procurement accept a staged-approval memo that your VP signs to allow procurement to issue the PO now and sign the amendment later? If yes, send a one-line confirmation and we'll prepare the DocuSign package.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Enterprise — Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmemedical.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmemedical.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — term ask and internal approvals

Vivek / Hannah — thanks, that path will work. VP can sign a staged-approval memo to allow issuing the PO now with the understanding the amendment will be signed later. Please proceed with the DocuSign package and include the SOC2 evidence bundle in the DocuSign reference so procurement can append to the PO.

Next steps (agreed):
- Redwood to send DocuSign private offer (12mo) + pre-filled amendment template for 36mo extension.
- Include SOC2-Redwood-evidence.zip and the redlined PO as attachments.
- Procurement to issue PO on receipt of signed staged-approval memo.

Jordan Lee
Procurement Manager — Acme Medical
Attachment: SOC2-Redwood-evidence.zip (ZIP)
